deliverables: Secondary marketplace for listing, pricing, and reselling tickets with on-chain settlement
Smart-contract royalty enforcement for artists and venues on resales
Configurable anti-scalping controls including price ceilings, transfer limits, identity-binding, and time restrictions
Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout's existing flow with self-custody export described for testnet milestone
Organizer dashboard and tools for resale parameters, ticket lifecycle data, royalty distributions, and verification
Independent third-party smart-contract security audit with remediation and published report
Public launch campaign, trade-show activations, metrics dashboard, and final governance report
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. and Intersect as budget administrator through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, security audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, stated as approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, over 8 months with milestone-gated disbursement.
Phase 1 of the ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet and was funded by Sellout with over $130,000 of its own capital.
Sellout has 200,000+ registered users, has issued 250,000+ tickets to date, and runs 350+ events annually at current cadence.
Phase 2 targets 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6M+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment expected to move over $6M through Cardano in year one, based on stated 2025 historical revenue of $5.88M.

The proposer commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism in which 25% of fees are paid quarterly until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter, with exact revenue-base definitions finalized in M1 contracting.
The budget includes named labor, development, marketing, audit, infrastructure, contingency, legal, and Intersect administration line items totaling 4,969,231 ada.
The proposer states that all on-chain metrics will be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data, policy-ID tracking, a public M5 dashboard, and quarterly Cardano Forum reports.

The proposer states that Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC smart-contract infrastructure with listed stake/payment addresses, independent oversight, and a public dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi.

The proposer states that Anvil/Sellout have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months and that the request does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit at submission.

summary: The document describes a 4,969,231 ada milestone-gated treasury withdrawal for an 8-month Phase 2 buildout of a Cardano-native ticketing platform, with claimed existing Sellout adoption, projected on-chain usage, budget administration through Intersect and TRSC/PSSC, and a contractual revenue-share repayment commitment.
